name: Pigment violet 2
description: Pigment Violet 2 (CAS 1326-04-1 ), also known commercially as Brillfast Vivid Magenta 6B and indexed under C.I. 45175 Lake, is a synthetic organic pigment delivering a vivid reddish-violet hue. Derived from the rhodamine dye family as a lake pigment, it provides strong tinting strength and brightness where intense violet-magenta shades are required across a broad range of industrial coloring applications. In printing inks, it is used to achieve high-chroma magenta tones in packaging, labels, and commercial print runs where color vibrancy is a primary specification for the final product. Coatings formulators incorporate it into decorative and industrial paints where a clean violet-red shade is needed at competitive loading levels to ensure cost-effective and high-quality results. Plastic compounders use it to color polymer substrates including PVC and polystyrene in consumer goods and packaging components. In textile and paper dyeing, it functions as a surface colorant. This pigment is supplied as a dry powder, the standard commercial form for pigment dispersion into liquid and solid matrices. It is available in technical grade for various industrial uses. Specifications are typically aligned to color strength, shade consistency, and purity requirements relevant to ink and coatings end uses. Packaging is commonly offered in fiber drums or multi-wall bags. These packaging options are suited to industrial procurement volumes, ensuring safe transport and storage for large-scale manufacturing operations requiring consistent pigment quality and performance.
